verdicts.reason: A: the stacking is clean and the headline and CTA lead, but the 'Find Ultra…' footer line sits between the first and second list items, the list is out of order (bubbles before herbs and honey), and the logo pill is shrunk to a tiny afterthought in the bottom corner. B has the same mid-list footer and reordering, plus worse problems: the headline sits on top of the pink circle, the bullet styles don't match (circle, diamonds, star) and the last item's text is tiny, the can floats in a large empty gap, and the logo pill is blown up to fill the full width at the bottom, out of proportion with everything else.
